versions.changelog:
Version 0.1.2 of Modeling Assistant

- No file changes detected in this version.
- No modifications to features, documentation, or workflow.

Version 0.1.1 of Modeling Assistant

- No file or documentation changes detected in this release.
- Functionality, workflow, and usage guidelines remain unchanged.

- Initial release of Modeling Assistant skill.
- Enables command-line control of Blender for automated 3D modeling and rendering tasks.
- Supports background (no-GUI) operation for efficient batch workflow.
- Generates reproducible Python scripts for creating and exporting 3D assets in both .obj and .blend formats.
- Provides users with clear feedback, model download paths, and modeling notes.
- Notifies users of scope limitations (e.g., animation and geometry nodes are not currently supported).
